stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 add [-n] [-v] [-u] <file-spec>...

Add file contents to the index.

Options:
    <file-spec>...
        the file (or files) to add to index
    -n, --dry-run
        don’t actually add the file(s), just show if they exist and/or will be ignored
    -v, --verbose
        be verbose
    -u, --update
        update tracked files
